name: membrane-to-actin-displacement-feedback
title: Coupler B · Membrane→actin displacement feedback
claim: TARGET (not yet tested): per-step mesh-position feedback preserves mesh quality and keeps tips inside their box potentials. Mesh-quality is currently inferred, not measured.
decision_figure: mesh-quality metrics vs time (min triangle area, max aspect ratio, inverted-face count, area/volume drift), gentle vs aggressive feedback side-by-side, plus tip–boundary distance
expected_pattern: min triangle area stays above threshold; zero inverted faces; tip–boundary distance > 0 (no collisions)
acceptance_threshold: min triangle area > 0 for the full run AND inverted-face count == 0
question: Does per-step mesh-position feedback from Mem3DG to ReaDDy preserve mesh quality (no vertex inversion or degenerate triangles) and keep tip particles within their box-potential bounds?

purpose.question: Does per-step mesh-position feedback from Mem3DG to ReaDDy preserve mesh quality (no vertex inversion or degenerate triangles) and keep tip particles within their box-potential bounds?
purpose.mechanism: After every Mem3DG step the coupler publishes updated wall_radius (planar) or membrane_vertex_positions (spherical) to ReaDDy as the new boundary. Aggressive force_constant or osmotic_force_scale can push the boundary past actin tips in one step, violating bond/box potentials.
purpose.expected_outcome: Min triangle area stays above a small positive threshold for the full run; no actin tip overshoots the membrane boundary by more than contact_threshold.

variants.name: gentle-feedback
variants.description: Small per-step displacements — mesh quality easily preserved.

variants.name: aggressive-feedback
variants.description: Large per-step displacements — stress test for vertex inversion / box-potential violation.

tests.name: mesh-quality-preserved-over-coupling-steps
tests.question: Min triangle area on the membrane mesh stays positive across the full run (no degenerate triangles or vertex inversion).

modified_processes: BrownianRatchetCoupler: instrument the mesh-position publication path so we can verify ReaDDy's tip constraints are updated cleanly per coupling tick.
model_change.notes: Tests that per-step mesh-position feedback from Mem3DG to ReaDDy preserves mesh quality (no degenerate triangles) and keeps tip particles within their bond/box potentials.

mechanism_uncertainty_addressed: Does per-step membrane→actin position feedback preserve mesh quality and keep tips inside their box potentials?
remaining_uncertainties: Mesh quality is currently inferred, not measured — runs.db emits vertex positions but not face connectivity / min triangle area / inverted-face count.

alternate_hypotheses.statement: Aggressive feedback gain pushes the boundary past actin tips in one step, degrading the mesh (inverted faces) or violating box potentials.
evidence_for: large osmotic_force_scale moves the boundary far per tick.

mechanism_update_proposals.statement: Feedback faithfulness is unverified pending mesh-quality observables.
